We need interpret. Stationery store sells pencil cases (笔袋) and pens (水笔). Pencil case 12 yuan each, water pen 2 yuan each. Promotion: buy one pencil case get one pen free. A person paid total 150 yuan, obtained pencil cases + pens total 35 items (including free gifts). Find number of pencil cases purchased.

Need set equation. Let x = number of pencil cases bought (paid). Since buy one case get one pen free, free pens = x. Let y = number of pens bought for money (not free). Total items: pencil cases x + free pens x + paid pens y = 2x + y = 35. Total payment: 12x + 2y = 150 (free pens no cost). Solve: y = 35 - 2x. Payment: 12x + 2(35-2x)=150 => 12x +70 -4x =150 => 8x=80 => x=10. Answer B.

Need ensure no ambiguity: "购得笔袋、水笔共35个（含赠品）" means total obtained (cases and pens) including gifts is 35. "某人共付款150元" paid for cases and paid pens. Yes.

content:
设此人购得笔袋 \(x\) 个。

因为促销期间“购一个笔袋送一个水笔”，所以获赠水笔也是 \(x\) 支。

设另外单独购买的水笔为 \(y\) 支。

根据“笔袋、水笔共 35 个（含赠品）”：

\[
x+x+y=35
\]

即：

\[
2x+y=35
\]

根据“共付款 150 元”：

\[
12x+2y=150
\]

由 \(y=35-2x\)，代入付款方程：

\[
12x+2(35-2x)=150
\]

\[
12x+70-4x=150
\]

\[
8x=80
\]

\[
x=10
\]

所以此人购得笔袋 10 个。

答案：B
